# Awesome GPT-6 Astra Demos

A curated collection of GPT-6 Astra demos: games, Blender & 3D, websites, and video creation. Discover what creators built, how Astra contributed, and where to see the original work.

We’ll keep adding new demos as we discover and review them. Star this repository to find it again, or suggest a demo through an issue.

**[Explore the visual gallery on MagicCreator →](<https://magiccreator.ai/astra>)** — browse previews, filter by category, and find creator-supplied live demos.

18 cases · 6 creator-supplied live links · Latest recorded review: 2026-09-07

This is a case directory, not a prompt collection or an independent benchmark. Model attribution, build times and results are based on the linked creator posts; inclusion does not mean the work has been reproduced or every demo tested. This is an independent community collection, not affiliated with OpenAI.

## GPT-6 Astra Video Creation Showcase

Examples of Astra contributing to video workflows through code, scene construction or orchestration. Other rendering, image and audio tools are credited separately.

### Blender to Seedance

A geometry-first workflow that turns a Blender scene into a rendered video.

**Creator:** [Amira Zairi](<https://x.com/azed_ai>) · **Tools / format:** Blender, Seedance 2.5

Astra codes the geometry; a Blender Clay Renderer plugin hands the scene to Dreamina / Seedance 2.5 for the final video. This is a creator-reported workflow in a post tagged DreaminaPartner, not an independent benchmark.

**Disclosure:** Partner post.

[Original post](<https://x.com/azed_ai/status/2096633164047565120>) · [Visual gallery details](<https://magiccreator.ai/astra/blender-to-seedance>)

### A Listing Becomes a Film

A house-listing photo set becomes a 3D house and a promotional video.

**Creator:** [Yunfan Ye](<https://x.com/realYunfanYe>) · **Tools / format:** 3D reconstruction, Video

Astra is credited with reconstructing the house and creating the video from listing photos. The author explicitly notes that some details are wrong; it should not be treated as an accurate property visualization.

[Original post](<https://x.com/realYunfanYe/status/2095612137582526615>) · [Visual gallery details](<https://magiccreator.ai/astra/zillow-house-video>)

Found a concrete Astra project worth including? Open an issue using the demo suggestion template. Please include the original creator’s post, what was built, and any live demo or code link. Prompts alone, unsupported performance claims and duplicate reposts are not enough. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
